 Negufest Euskadi 
 Negufest 2027 in Bilbao and Getxo: Fito & Fitipaldis, Los Enemigos, Izaro and Standstill, dates and tickets for its 24 concerts
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Lucas Moreno 
 19 Nov 2026, 16:00 
 A 4-minute read 
 Negufest 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Fito & Fitipaldis open Negufest with four nights at the Euskalduna, and few tickets are left : 26 and 27 December and 8 and 9 January. 
 The series brings together 24 winter concerts in Bilbao and Getxo , from 26 December to 27 February, with Los Enemigos, Standstill, Pignoise, Wim Mertens, Violeta and Morgan, and with Izaro closing at the Euskalduna. 
 January and February focus on rock and singer-songwriters in club venues : Kafe Antzokia, Santana 27 and Azkena host most of the dates, and Getxo stages its shows at Muxikebarri. 
 Each concert has its own ticket, from €8 : the cheapest is Mockers Day and the most expensive is Izaro, from €29 to €46; Fito and Pignoise are down to their last tickets. 
 Bilbao and Getxo now have their winter of concerts. Negufest , the Basque brand of the Inverfest circuit, has finalised a programme of 24 dates between 26 December and 27 February , with Fito & Fitipaldis as the opening draw and Izaro closing, and all tickets on sale.
 Festival guide 
 Negufest Euskadi 2027 
 26 Dec 2026 – 27 Feb 2027 · Palacio Euskalduna, Bilbao 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 Fito & Fitipaldis, four nights at the Euskalduna
 Fito is playing at home. Fito Cabrales's band fills the start of the series with four concerts in the auditorium of the Palacio Euskalduna : Saturday 26 and Sunday 27 December , and Friday 8 and Saturday 9 January , all at 20:00 , with doors at 19:15. They arrive with Aullidos Tour. Teatros y Auditorios , the part of their tour designed for theatres and auditoriums.
 All four dates are listed as last tickets on the band's website. Tickets are sold through the Euskalduna itself, which does not show the price until you start the booking process.
 Los Enemigos play on 15 January at Santana 27. Image: Negufest The full Negufest 2027 calendar
 These are the 24 dates published on the festival's website, with the start time of each concert:
 Saturday 26 and Sunday 27 December: Fito & Fitipaldis (Euskalduna, 20:00).
 Friday 8 January: Fito & Fitipaldis (Euskalduna, 20:00) and Carlos Núñez with Celtic Beethoven (Muxikebarri, Getxo, 20:00).
 Saturday 9 January: Fito & Fitipaldis (Euskalduna, 20:00) and Mockers Day, with Micky & The Buzz, Rubia & The Bandits, 3 From Hell and Pleasure James & The Unsatisfied Minds (Santana 27, 19:00).
 Friday 15 January: Los Enemigos (Santana 27, 21:00) and The Rapants (Kafe Antzokia, 22:00).
 Saturday 16 January: Standstill , with Vida y obra de un titiritero (Kafe Antzokia, 22:00).
 Friday 22 January: Bernal (Azkena, 21:00) and Pignoise , marking 20 years of Anunciado en televisión (Santana 27, 21:00).
 Sunday 24 January: Rock en Familia, the family show I Love Rock & Roll (Muxikebarri, 18:00).
 Saturday 30 January: Poncho K (Santana 27, 21:00).
 Friday 5 February: Wim Mertens solo piano (Muxikebarri, 20:00), Eneritz Furyak (Azkena, 21:00), Los Zigarros (Santana 27, 21:00) and Reality (Stage Live, 21:00).
 Saturday 6 February: Sho-Hai (Kafe Antzokia, 22:00) and Rubén Pozo (Azkena, 20:30).
 Friday 12 February: Violeta , with La última escena (Muxikebarri, 20:00).
 Saturday 13 February: Morgan (Teatro Arriaga, 19:00) and La Cabra Mecánica (Kafe Antzokia, 22:00).
 Sunday 14 February: Tito Ramírez (Kafe Antzokia, 19:00).
 Saturday 27 February: Izaro, with Arkitektura (Euskalduna).
 Beyond Fito, the weight lies in January and February and in the club venues. Kafe Antzokia , Santana 27 and Azkena share 13 of the 24 dates, with names from Spanish rock and pop such as Los Enemigos, Standstill, Los Zigarros and La Cabra Mecánica, plus the rap of Sho-Hai. Getxo provides the counterpoint at Muxikebarri , with auditorium formats: Carlos Núñez's bagpipes, Wim Mertens's minimalist piano, Violeta and an afternoon for families. Friday 5 February is the busiest day, with four concerts at the same time in four different venues.
 The closing show by Izaro at the Euskalduna has a start time still to be confirmed: Negufest lists 20:30 and the venue's website 20:00.
 Prices and where to buy each concert
 There is no single ticket sale: each listing on the Negufest website links to its ticketing platform, which is the venue's or the promoter's. These are the starting prices shown on 19 November:
 Up to €20: Mockers Day (€8 to €12), Eneritz Furyak (from €13.50), Bernal (from €15.50), Rock en Familia (€19.09) and The Rapants and Tito Ramírez (from €20).
 €20 to €30: Reality (€22; €47 with a meet-and-greet with the artist), Morgan (€22 to €42), Carlos Núñez (€26.09), Poncho K (€27), Sho-Hai and Rubén Pozo (from €27.50) and La Cabra Mecánica (from €29).
 Over €30: Los Enemigos and Standstill (from €31) and Wim Mertens and Violeta (€31.09). Izaro ranges from €29 to €46.
 No price published outside the booking process: Fito & Fitipaldis, Pignoise and Los Zigarros.
 No date is sold out. Fito's and Pignoise's are listed as last tickets , and Reality and La Cabra Mecánica show medium availability. The Getxo prices with cents suggest they already include booking fees; for the rest, it is worth checking the total before paying.
 Negufest is the Basque version of the circuit presented in Madrid as Inverfest; its programme is in the Inverfest 2027 calendar . Any changes to Negufest will be added to its listing , and the rest of the Basque winter to the festivals in the Basque Country listings.
 Sources: official Negufest website (programme and individual concert listings) and the ticketing platforms linked from them (Onebox, Janto for Euskalduna and Getxo Kultura, Codetickets, Entradeo, Notikumi, pignoisetickets.com and Teatro Arriaga), consulted on 19 November 2026; official Fito & Fitipaldis website, for the sales status of their concerts; Palacio Euskalduna website, for Izaro's start time.
